checks: The average of the face centroids is a containing mark. Any affine margin nonnegative at that average is nonnegative at at least one face centroid. A whole-face trace contributes 1/r, and a proper trace can be tightened through that centroid without increasing mass.

For any mark in J choose a positive group total t and a relative barycentric coordinate b at least 1/(D+1). The proposed margin at the mark is t b minus t b plus tδ minus η(1−t), exactly zero, while on all other faces it is −η.

The face trace is a homothetic vertex cap of volume fraction (1−b+δ)^D. Small positive η keeps the threshold positive and at most one. If t=1 then δ=0, including the zero-volume vertex trace when b=1. Nonconstancy on the chosen face makes the extended ambient halfspace proper. A mark outside the compact simplex has a strictly separating halfspace.
